why: Controls the constructed-renderer pass finds under this project's own 28px coarse-pointer floor, on real production renderer output no fixture in scenarios.mjs ever mounted. Not an allowance: every one of these is a real shortfall, exactly like the fixture baseline it sits beside. The remaining classes here are recurrences the fixture baseline already tracks, now also visible on the real renderer at production row counts (a control the fixture pass measured once shows up here dozens or hundreds of times because a 1600-2000 row bench table/gallery/calendar/timeline actually repeats it). Resizing them is the same operator-scale decision the fixture baseline's own `why` describes, not a repair this pass makes silently.

raiseHistory.what: 367 -> 9974, and the ratchet is raised, not lowered, for the 037-timeline-gantt-port REQ-007 1:1 reference-copy leg: the timeline's default render (timelineLocalExtensions unset/false) switched from the local db-timeline-* markup to a structural copy of obsidian-pm's GanttView/GanttHeaderRenderer/GanttTaskBarRenderer/TimelineConfig DOM tree and class vocabulary. The reference's own controls bar and per-row add-subtask affordance are bare Obsidian `clickable-icon` buttons with no bespoke sizing (the reference's own gantt.css carries no rule for them, and this plugin's styles.css does not size `clickable-icon` either — that class's real touch size in a live vault comes from Obsidian's own core stylesheet, which this harness does not load), so at the bench's 1600-row fixture scale, across the six timeline scenarios render-assertion-bundle.mjs mounts (timeline/file-view, timeline/embed, timeline-day/file-view, timeline-month/file-view, timeline-quarter/file-view, timeline-year/file-view), the per-row add-subtask button and the eight-button controls bar (five scale buttons, Today, Expand all, Collapse all) multiply to a large but structurally expected count. Three classes tied to the retired local nav chrome (db-timeline-create-button, db-timeline-nav-button, db-timeline-scale-menu) disappear from this pass because the default render no longer mounts that chrome; local-extension mode (timelineLocalExtensions: true) still renders it, unmeasured here. No styles.css change accompanies this raise; the CSS leg for the ported gantt.css block is a separate, later leg (spec.md REQ-005/T021) and is expected to leave this count of interactive elements unchanged (it styles borders/fills/typography, not button dimensions).

note: The constructed pass first ran against no baseline at all (2026-09-03) and measured 8503 under-floor controls across 12 classes, red before any fix or declaration existed. Five of the twelve were newly discovered here — invisible to the fixture pass because no scenarios.mjs fixture mounts them: db-row-insert-button (22x22, 3998 instances — the table's hover-to-insert-row button, repeated at every row gap in the 2000-row bench table), db-gallery-card-open (24x24, 3200 instances — the gallery card's open button), db-timeline-mobile-menu-button (22x22, 960 instances — the timeline's phone-only overflow menu button, ironically missing the floor its own name promises), db-board-pagination-dot (12x12, 10 instances) and db-calendar-week-allday-more (67x13, 16 instances). db-board-pagination-dot is declared, not counted here: its `::before` inset is -16px on every side of a 12px dot, a 44px effective hit area a bounding box does not see (styles.css:19696-19699), the same shape as the checkbox exemption in touch-targets.mjs's DECLARED list, which now names it. The remaining four (8493 = 8503 - 10) were real, recorded here rather than fixed. A fix was drafted and verified for three of them the first time this pass ran, then reverted rather than landed because landing it would have invalidated the sourceHashes on eight unrelated census/audit artefacts (cascade-audit, checkbox-appearance, checkbox-inventory, design-conformance, engine-parity, surface-census, token-census, view-census); re-stamping surfaced that two of the eight — checkbox-appearance (a pre-existing 2.99:1 border-contrast shortfall on a board-drop-language fixture) and engine-parity (pre-existing Chrome/WebKit width differences, 520 vs 512, on unrelated fixtures) — fail for reasons that predate any touch-target work, confirmed by running both against the untouched tree: identical failing output. Those two remain a different scope's problem (WCAG contrast and cross-engine tolerance, not touch targets) and are recorded unchanged rather than fixed incidentally. This time the fix was landed: see `lastTriage` above for the applied change, the per-class before/after count, and the verification that produced them. db-calendar-week-allday-more (67x13, a real `<button>` inside the week/day all-day overflow row) was never a fix candidate for this pass regardless: raising its height sits inside the calendar's CSS-grid all-day row track (`grid-row` positioning shared with event-segment bars), an area this program's own history already flags as fragile (the runtime-vars.css calendar-formula finding), so it stays deferred pending a dedicated pass with its own capture verification. The other 7 recurring classes (db-calendar-month-segment 200, db-calendar-more-events 56, db-calendar-week-allday-date 16, db-table-footer-trigger 32, db-timeline-create-button 1, db-timeline-nav-button 12, db-timeline-scale-menu 2 — 319 total) are the same shortfalls the fixture baseline already tracks, now also counted at the scale a real renderer repeats them; 319 + db-calendar-week-allday-more's 16 = 335, the new baseline.
